Güç(8)/Beceri(9) are server-sent attributes (v6 has no Güç/Zeka/Bünye/Beceri point rows: constructor 00403e8b only builds Dirençler pool 22 and Üretim pool 23). bots.provenance: NONCANONICAL: the original game had no server-side bots.
